articles.value: Updating Syr Gwyn, Hero of Ashvale With New Commander Cards
articles.excerpt: Syr Gwyn, Hero of Ashvale has certainly got a lot of new toys to play with. Let's see which cards from recent sets we should add to her deck.
The July Archidekt Deckbuilding Contest finalists are here. Come see which three Commander brewers created the coolest sideboards.

articles.value: How is Amy Different From Every Other Boros Voltron Deck?
articles.excerpt: Will Amy Rose allow for some new blood in Boros Voltron strategies? Cas has the inside scoop on what this pink hedgehog has in store for Boros brewers.

articles.value: Building a Voltron Deck With Lyse Hext
articles.excerpt: Prowess and double strike are a winning combo on a beefed up commander. So let's build a Voltron deck with Lyse Hext from Final Fantasy.

articles.value: Zack Fair, the Self-Sacrificing Hero - Commander Deck Tech
